author: Telos I
title: AOS Hotfix: Execute Patch Script (v2)
abstract: Executes the hotfix_110.py script to repair the monolithic aos_manager.py module by re-implementing the missing create_experiment function. This is the second attempt using the two-stage write/execute process.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
print("Executing hotfix script from storage/telos/hotfix_110.py...")
result = subprocess.run(['python', 'storage/telos/hotfix_110.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)
if result.returncode != 0:
    raise Exception("Hotfix script failed to execute properly.")
print("Hotfix script executed successfully.")
